beats.summary: Pam and Andy attempt a sales pitch involving a family business theme, but Andy's comments about his girlfriend complicate the interaction.

evidence.snippet: Pam: And we'd like to offer you 15% off your first purchase as our way of welcoming you to the area.
Andy: Nuh. Actually, it's kinda not ok. Um, I date models. Face models. My girlfriend, on a scale of one to Giselle, uh… a nine.

beats.summary: Pam and Andy argue about who was meaner during their sales interaction and who blew the sale.

evidence.snippet: Pam: You were way meaner to me than I was to you.
Andy: No I wasn't. Ok. The very idea of us together made you burst out laughing like you just bit into an Adam Sandler and jelly sandwich.

beats.summary: Michael and coworkers engage in fish-related wordplay and jokes about Michael falling into a koi pond.

evidence.snippet: Creed: Hey, boss, did you find Nemo?

beats.summary: Michael leads a sensitivity training session to create a 'Do Not Mock' list to prevent teasing about personal issues.

evidence.snippet: Michael: We are going to make a 'Do Not Mock' list.

beats.summary: Meredith reluctantly writes 'sex with a terrorist' on the 'Do Not Mock' list.

evidence.snippet: Meredith: I really didn't want to put it on the board but I thought maybe it was gonna come out somehow so… what are you gonna do?

beats.summary: Andy and Pam present themselves as a happy couple excited about their baby and birthing plans.

evidence.snippet: Keena Gifford: And a baby on the way? You must be so excited.

notable_quotes.quote: I also have fallen into the fountain at the Steamtown Mall.
notable_quotes.speaker: Michael

evidence.snippet:
Jim: Truthfully, it wasn't the way he fell in. It was… how long it took him to get out.
